methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic units based on individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This ensures a granular comparison between the two information sources.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Shift register has four D flops.
Input 'in' is the serial data input to the first flip-flop.
Output 'out' is the output of the last flip-flop.
When resetn is low, all flip-flops will be reset to 0 on the rising edge of the clock.
spec_atomic_units: Implements a 4-bit shift register with a synchronous active-low reset.
On the rising edge of clk, if resetn is low, all flip-flops are reset to 0.
Data at in is shifted into the first flip-flop.
Data in each flip-flop is shifted to the next flip-flop.
Output out reflects the value of the last flip-flop after the rising edge of clk.
The combinational logic consists of four 2-to-1 multiplexers, each controlled by the resetn signal, and each feeding the D input of a corresponding D flip-flop.
The output 'out' is directly the output of the last flip-flop
Internal implementation will contain four `reg` declarations, one for each flip-flop.
